exceptions.reason: Conditional server-side SNI/mTLS flaw in Netty embedded by grpc-netty-shaded 1.84.0. AINovel uses only grpc-client-spring-boot-starter; it creates no gRPC Netty server, SniHandler, or per-SNI mTLS routing. Runtime no-server test and source/dependency inspection are recorded in doc/versions/v1.0/audit/remediation/security-exception-shaded-netty.md. Reassess on next gRPC release; exception expires 2026-10-15. Upstream: https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-c4c3-7fpv-j4q5
